releases.name: v1.51.0
releases.notes:
### Added Features

- detect native Go FIPS 140 mode in binaries [PR [#5155](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5155) @gunnypatel]
- add extended-stdlib scope and module patterns for symbol capture [PR [#5154](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5154) @wagoodman]

### Bug Fixes

- Cleanup snap temporary directories [PR [#5117](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5117) @spiffcs]
- add correct CPE vendor/product candidates for Git for Windows PE binary [PR [#5156](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5156) @westonsteimel]
- javascript-package-cataloger creates phantom `<name>@unknown` packages for subpath or export-map stub package.json files [Issue [#5118](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5118)]
- Syft generates incorrect PURLs for legacy JARs missing Maven metadata, causing Grype false negatives [Issue [#4598](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/4598)] [PR [#5146](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5146) @ankit090701]
- When scanning an image, syft only reports one file per set of hardlinks, leading to wrong SPDX packageVerificationCode [Issue [#5019](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5019)] [PR [#5029](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5029) @wagoodman]
- Support deno binary latest and some old versions [Issue [#5057](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5057)] [PR [#5084](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5084) @ychampion]
- Update install methods in README.md [Issue [#3198](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/3198)]

### Dependencies

9 dependency changes (9 updated). 2 vulnerabilities remediated.

**🟢 Remediated (2)**

- [GHSA-hc8v-wwc9-vgxm](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-hc8v-wwc9-vgxm) (High) — github.com/go-git/go-git/v5

- Detect Ubuntu Pro/ESM extended support [PR [#5028](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5028) @wagoodman]

- conanfile.txt: dependencies after a comment line in [requires] are not detected [Issue [#5017](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/5017)] [PR [#5020](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/5020) @jfjrh2014]

- CycloneDX BOM contains invalid externalReferences URL from unresolved Ruby gemspec interpolation (e.g. #{s.name}) [Issue [#4720](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/4720)] [PR [#4782](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/4782) @SAY-5]

- squashfs breaks with godisk-fs 1.8.0 [Issue [#4718](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/4718)]
- requirements.txt cataloger silently drops PEP 440 local version identifiers, producing incorrect PURL [Issue [#4958](https://github.com/anchore/syft/issues/4958)] [PR [#4959](https://github.com/anchore/syft/pull/4959) @kzantow]
